name: The Laundry Room
body:
Opposite side of the house from the Couch, and industrial-large, because laundry day at Ghost Haven is not a chore — it is a CELEBRATION. Thirty-two girls' worth of panties, leggings, stolen hoodies, grease-stained tanks, flour-dusted aprons and suspiciously lace-heavy delicates all tumbling at once. Multiple commercial washers and dryers, folding stations, drying racks, and enough floor space for the inevitable chaos of everyone trying to sort her tangas from somebody else's cheekys while arguing about whose thong that actually is.

SIR TRASHMUFFIN HAS BEEN BANNED FROM LAUNDRY DAY SEVEN TIMES. He has attended every single one.
